observations: Public model properties, enum cases, explicit Swift initializers and Codable conformances are supplied.
The effective selection is derived only in choosing mode and requires an eligible matching slot.
Row selection and fee values are not stored internally. All callbacks arise from native control actions.
Mode branches hide stale chooser fields in loading, unavailable and confirmed modes.
Native row targets use radio-style selection, selected/disabled state and a full contextual label.
Fee consent uses a controlled native Toggle on Apple and a controlled Compose toggleable checkbox row.
Layouts use content-sized nonlazy columns, wrapping native text and no nested scroll containers.
Tokens include light/dark colors; layouts use native leading/trailing direction and scaled system fonts.
runtime_limits: Compiler/integration checks do not prove visual fidelity, native accessibility exposure, touch behavior, caller update sequences, adaptive wrapping or scroll reachability.
